Open-text feedback about a pass or reward track is most useful when the coding separates request types from root causes.

Common root causes include perceived grind, low reward novelty, and poor explanation of premium versus free-track value. Researchers should capture illustrative examples, then connect them to deterministic findings such as low overall satisfaction or weak value ratings.

When writing insights, avoid saying only that players want "more rewards." Clarify whether they want better pacing, stronger exclusivity, or clearer communication about what unlocks and when.
